title: Discov3r
tagline: Discov3r:Discover to Earn, Real-World Exploring Web3 Game, Web3 version of Geocaching
description:
Discov3r is Web3 version of Geocaching.

There are 2 actors:
- Maker creates Treasure Box and hide it in the real world
- Explorer finds Treasure Box and obtains crypto assets

There are 2 ways to earn
- TreasureBox
  - TreasureBox itself is ERC-721 token
  - It can put either Native Token(Ether / MATIC), ERC20, ERC-721
- Portal
  - Discov3r token can be earned when checking in
  - A person can checkin only once per portal
how_its_made:
Chain: Polygon / Optimism
Contract: Solidity / Hardhat
Frontend: Vanilla JS / jQuery / Ethers.js / Bootstrap 
Backend: Firebase
Personhood verification: World ID (Worldcoin) => Only verified people create an Treasure Box and Check-in portal.
Hardware: NFC sticker / Smart Lock
Hardware Interaction: Midpoint enables an interaction with the real world object through Discov3r smart contract.
